messages:
Nina: Quick design sync: updated playground run-list mock. Goal: make tool/schema context visible without clutter. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/runlist-compact.png

AJ: Love the compact rows. Suggestion: single-line summary with small chevron. Example:
```
▸ 2026-03-20 09:05 — SummarizeText — success — 220ms
```
Chevron should be first tabbable control.

Samir: Copy change: use "Tool definitions" instead of "Function defs" across UI. Also change modal title to "Tool examples & schema".

Lee: Accessibility:
- Ensure chevron has aria-expanded and visible focus ring.
- Streaming area should use aria-live="polite" only for new tokens.
- Status chips need higher contrast or an outline.

a11y-bot: Auto-scan flagged 3 issues: low-contrast chips, missing accessible name on chevron in current build, missing label on example-insert button. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/1869000001

Nina: Action items:
- AJ: prototype collapsed-row + on-demand expand (due Thu)
- Lee: PR for aria-live/focus ring/contrast (due Wed)
- Samir: copy pass for toolbar/modal/button text (small PR)

AJ: Question — when expanded show pretty schema or raw JSON by default?

Samir: Pretty schema default; add "View raw" toggle. Provide an "Insert example" button next to snippets with aria-label.

Lee: Also add keyboard shortcuts: / to focus prompt, k to focus run search, e to expand focused run. Add legend to help overlay.

Nina: Thanks — will collect mocks and walk through Monday 9am.
